title: COVID-19 Testing - Tampa Bay Family Clinic
description: Tampa Bay Family Clinics provides accessible COVID-19 testing to the community. Tests are observed and directed by a healthcare worker.

outline.text: Testing is the only way we can confirm if you have COVID-19. Knowing you're infected is important to protect your family and the people you encounter. Testing helps reduce the spread of the virus. When someone tests positive for COVID-19, they can be isolated at home or, if needed, in a hospital.

One thing we know for sure – every single person can help our country control the COVID-19 pandemic. From wearing a mask to washing your hands to maintaining physical distance and avoiding large indoor gatherings.

A positive test, alerts an individual that they have the infection. Not only can they get treated faster, but they can take steps to minimize the spread of the virus. This is why it is so important to get the test results quickly.

If not up to date on vaccines and have no symptoms or exposure: return to normal activities. Take steps to get up to date on vaccines to protect yourself and others.

Coronaviruses are a type of virus. There are a lot of different kinds, and some cause sickness. A coronavirus identified in 2019, SARS-CoV-2, has caused a pandemic of respiratory illness, called COVID-19.

So far, researchers know that the coronavirus is spread through virus particles and droplets released into the air when an infected person coughs, talks, breathes, sneezes, laughs or sings. Larger droplets may fall to the ground in a few seconds, but small infectious particles can linger in the air and accumulate in indoor places, principally where there is poor ventilation and a lot of people are gathered. This is why physical distancing, hand hygiene and mask-wearing are crucial to preventing COVID-19.

The first case of COVID-19 was reported Dec. 1, 2019, and the cause was a then-new coronavirus later named SARS-CoV-2. SARS-CoV-2 may have originated in an animal and changed (mutated) so it could cause disease in humans. In the past, a few infectious disease sudden appearance have been traced to viruses originating in bats birds, pigs and other animals that mutated to become murderous to humans. Research continues, and more study may reveal why and how the coronavirus evolved to cause pandemic disease.
What To Expect During Your Covid-19 Testing In Tampa Florida
For a COVID-19 diagnostic test, our health care specialist takes a sample of saliva or a sample of mucus from your nose or throat.

Few places offer saliva tests. While a saliva sample may be slightly less perceptive than a mucus sample taken with a long nasal swab, a saliva test is easier to do and often less unpleasant. You spit into a tube a few times to provide a sample of your saliva for testing.. The tube is sealed before it is sent to a laboratory for analysis.

A long nasal swab (nasopharyngeal swab) is recommended, although a shorter or very short nasal swab or throat swab is acceptable. Our healthcare professional inserts a thin, flexible stick with cotton brushes at the back of your throat or at the tip inside your nose to collect a mucus sample.
How long does the COVID-19 Testing process take?
The collection of the sample for the COVID-19 test will only take about 5-15 minutes max. You’ll be in and out.
I tested positive; what do I do?
Get plenty of rest and stay hydrated.
Always wear a mask to cover your mouth and nose when around other people.
Always wash your hands especially before preparing food or after coughing.
Avoid touching your face with unwashed hands.
Avoid sharing personal items such as cups, utensils, towels, etc.
Always clean and disinfect the room that you're staying in.
